## Summary

I successfully resolved ticket T-6001 by investigating the search-api HPA scaling issue. The problem was that the 4.8.0 release changed the pod specification (adding a `log-forwarder` sidecar container), but the HPA configuration wasn't updated to account for this change. The HPA now shows "cpu <unknown>" because it cannot properly calculate metrics with the new container layout. I provided the ticket owner with a concrete fix: update the HPA to use ContainerResource metrics to explicitly track the `api` container (which has CPU requests defined) while ignoring the sidecar, which will restore autoscaling functionality.
